comment: Conformance-note count — Existing requirements name generic functions but do not ensure that any offered server actually implements ICD-11's distinctive model and coding workflow. The conditional status avoids requiring every country or every deployed service to implement an unused standard. Evidence: WHO API (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/APIDoc-Version2/), Embedded Coding Tool (https://icd.who.int/docs/icd-api/icd11ect-1.8/EmbeddedCodingTool/), Reference Guide (https://icdcdn.who.int/icd11referenceguide/en/refguide.pdf).
